packageRules.description: OpenCloud production base image (:production channel) - group + label; PR only, manual review (consistent with the other repos). OpenCloud is stateful and versions can migrate data, so a human merges each bump after a glance at the release notes.

OpenCloud rolling base image (:rolling channel, carries reva#720 / the large-folder-sync fix) - group + label; PR only, manual review (consistent with the other repos). OpenCloud is stateful and versions can migrate data, so a human merges each bump after a glance at the release notes.
Static gosu privilege-drop helper image (multi-stage COPY --from)
GitHub Actions: auto-merge all updates. No CI runs on PRs, so platformAutomerge merges as soon as the PR is open.

customManagers.description: Track BOTH OpenCloud base pins (production + rolling) from the Dockerfile ARGs
